address: 24F, The Okura Prestige Bangkok, 57 Wireless Road, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok, 10330, Thailand
bio: The Okura Prestige’s Japanese restaurant boasts 3 dining areas: a sushi bar, teppanyaki grills and a stylish dining room. The fish is sourced weekly from Toyosu market in Japan, and they offer a rotating selection of sashimi options, depending on availability. Dressed in traditional kimono, the staff make every effort to ensure that diners have a great experience, while the panoramic high-rise cityscape offers a romantic setting that couples adore....
